problem.title: Three Sum: Find all unique triplets that sum to zero
problem.description: Given an array of integers, return all unique triplets [a, b, c] such that a + b + c = 0. The result should not contain duplicate triplets. Each triplet should be sorted in non-decreasing order. The input array may contain negative, positive, and zero values. Aim for O(n^2) time after sorting; you can assume the input length is at least 3.
